fusions.name: Bloodcap Dart
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Fires a spore dart that deals 8 blood damage and gives the target Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roost Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek carries spores through a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 resonating damage that ignores resistances to everything in it, with a 50% chance per hit to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cave Murk
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies in a spore cloud for 6 seconds and restores 8 health. While veiled you move 11% faster and enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Night Feeder
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
